expected: HTTP failures, truncated SSE, disconnects and queue/cancel faults cannot falsely succeed or repeat completed side effects.
limitations: OMP retries cannot be disabled on openai-completions: HTTP 500 produced 12 identical requests (6 transport x 2 provider attempts) with retry.enabled=false.
observed: HTTP 400/401/404/500, dropped connections, malformed SSE, in-band errors, SIGINT and --max-time stalls all end as errors with no false completion, and a resumed session does not repeat a completed side effect. Three expected failures record a real defect in the composed stock stack: when the model's turn ends inside a tool call, Strata closes the partial arguments and reports finish_reason tool_calls (or stop), and stock OMP executes the tool with truncated arguments (a partial file write happens; exit 0). finish_reason length is handled safely (no execution).
reason: Stock OMP 18.4.0 executes tool calls whose arguments were truncated when Strata reports tool_calls/stop; upstream defect, no supported setting avoids it.
